verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a named Open Source Software practice page. It says the team advises companies that develop and use OSS, including avoiding problematic licensing issues and ensuring license compliance, so the license-compliance part of the story is documented first-party. The evidence never mentions drafting or counseling on OSS usage policies for product companies, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of OSS usage-policy counseling, more detail on the depth of the compliance service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability

citations.quote: Our Open Source Software team advises companies that develop and use open source software (OSS) and those that invest in OSS businesses
Avoiding problematic OSS licensing issues and ensuring license compliance.
